QuestInfo.name: Patience's Paw Stamp
QuestInfo.0: You need paw stamps from the town foxes to be acknowledged as a fox. Go to Patience to take the third test.
QuestInfo.1: Patience wants you to stop the #o2400206#s from picking on the kits. Defeat those monsters and get Patience's paw stamp.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the test and got Patience's paw stamp of approval.

0.0: Finally, you're here! I hope you're as good as Teacher says. The chicks living around here are vicious little things, picking on our poor kits. We need someone to teach them a lesson, and it looks like that someone is you. Can you do it?
0.1: Our babies are going to learn to fear chicks unless we do something. You won't stand for that, will you? It's unnatural!

yes.0: Great, just kick around #r60 #o2400206#s#k for us. That should teach them to clean up their act. Now hurry! Time's wasting!

no.0: If the adults get involved, the mother chickens will come over and pick a fight with us. Better for a scrawny human to take care of it for us.

1.0: Did you rough up all the #o2400206#s?

yes.0: Finally. I can breathe a little easier without those stupid chicks poking around our kits. Here, take my paw stamp. You earned it. #rMrs. #p3002008##k will have your next test.  \r\n                                                                 #fUI/DialogImage.img/quest/0

default.0: Defeat #r60 #o2400206#s#k and I'll give you my paw stamp of approval.
